lanes.name: Architecture and causal dependency map
lanes.hypothesis: True original source-to-decision dependency and producer-consumer state differ from a textual architecture claim
lanes.baseline: Existing current owner source and publication readback
lanes.falsifier: An actual source-edge or consumer mismatch that falsifies claimed live end-to-end mapping
lanes.decision_relevant_output: Prioritized source-to-decision repair with original affected producer and consumer, or REJECTED_NO_DEFECT
lanes.scientific_stop_condition: Reproduce one upstream mismatch under original owner; no duplicated parallel architecture
lanes.reactivation_trigger: New current HEAD/consumer mismatch or owner source-fingerprint change

lanes.name: Original forecast accuracy and baseline admission
lanes.hypothesis: One pre-issued and first-known source-eligible native forecast outperforms matched same-clock persistence after dependence adjustment
lanes.baseline: Previous packet price delta, no-change, momentum and source-matched range
lanes.falsifier: No eligible native original cohort, insufficient independent shocks or cheaper baseline equals/exceeds the official score
lanes.decision_relevant_output: Full original issued/NOT_ISSUED/ABSTAIN and censored denominator, metrics and source statuses; prospective experiment if blocked
lanes.scientific_stop_condition: Only PIT-admitted rows score as original edge; no 11 historical attempts re-labeled as valid
lanes.reactivation_trigger: Authenticated first-known and pre-issued complete source, enough due outcomes and new independent shock group

lanes.name: Pullback warning risk and missed crash failure atlas
lanes.hypothesis: Risk 3/5 warning is systematically late before qualifying severe deterioration and source-legal earlier risk-review is feasible
lanes.baseline: Original 3/5 or HOLD, matched no-crash volatile windows, full no-warning clock grid
lanes.falsifier: Earlier legal evidence absent, added false alerts outweigh lead or negative original Round2 remains unrepaired
lanes.decision_relevant_output: Failure atlas with first-legal warnings, lead delay, false alarms, no-alert denominators and owner repair only if reproduced
lanes.scientific_stop_condition: Warning != SELL. Never claim pre-crash action using market tape unavailable at original cutoffs
lanes.reactivation_trigger: Eligible original warnings plus independent noncrash control, delivery receipt and genuine source-first-known

lanes.name: First-known source, cadence and quote integrity
lanes.hypothesis: Source freshness or original clock mismatch affects genuine official forecasts or actual site receipt
lanes.baseline: Original source-health and frozen snapshot, baseline observed source clock
lanes.falsifier: Packet health PASS but required source clock unavailable/stale or USD/USDT or restricted-plane breach
lanes.decision_relevant_output: Evidence-scoped per-source completeness, abstentions, responsible source owner issue and smallest repair
lanes.scientific_stop_condition: Private SC01/03/14 only prospective collection; no Round3 outcomes and no cadence expansion without measured 3000-minute budget
lanes.reactivation_trigger: Original owner source/run/health changes or measured source-job P50/P95 billing and release cap

lanes.name: Indicator incrementality and negative-result ablations
lanes.hypothesis: One indicator family adds source-legal out-of-time information over price/vol and cheapest alternative
lanes.baseline: Price/vol baseline with Ironflow corrected null and existing ETF/breadth negative results
lanes.falsifier: No corrected confidence interval excluding null, no available PIT or apparent lift disappears across regimes
lanes.decision_relevant_output: KEEP IMPROVE SHADOW RETIRE matrix with sample sizes, multiplicity and actual owner actions
lanes.scientific_stop_condition: No duplicate 72-file download, no reoptimizing exposed Ironflow history and no production rule promotion
lanes.reactivation_trigger: New independent source-legal cohort or new corrected original owner evidence

lanes.name: Seven-day W46 original forecast and Site Graph B
lanes.hypothesis: A valid original Monday W46 issues and freezes seven daily BTC+ETH closes and low/high and renders true blue and independently sourced green actuals
lanes.baseline: W45 original 0/7 honest abstention, naive no-change expected close and correctly labeled original outcome
lanes.falsifier: Any fake original week, incomplete pre-issue 168h, USD/USDT mismatch, wrong source hash or CDN blue line not bound to frozen 7/7
lanes.decision_relevant_output: Native 2026-11-09 original producer job, immutable freeze, seven close/range checks, actual CDN readback or exact failure and next trigger
lanes.scientific_stop_condition: Preserve Graph B Github-only design. Live green latency not standalone veto; no second paid POST
lanes.reactivation_trigger: Actual scheduled Monday issuer and CDN/Graph History provenance, or a new reproducible source gate

lanes.name: Preregistered alternative Kompas Shadow models
lanes.hypothesis: One preregistered cheap regime-aware or source-aware challenger adds independent out-of-time utility rather than ex-post sample tuning
lanes.baseline: Original official admitted forecast and persistence, momentum and volatility-only
lanes.falsifier: Candidate advantage disappears on purged time groups, test multiplicity, independent regime shock or unavailability controls
lanes.decision_relevant_output: Version-frozen shadow candidate with same-clock primary endpoint and explicit rejection or due-only forward registration
lanes.scientific_stop_condition: No official model change, 144 synthetic variants are not 144 real tests, separate training from untouched holdout
lanes.reactivation_trigger: Source-eligible independent family and preregistered future outcomes matured

lanes.name: Investor after-cost risk review versus HOLD
lanes.hypothesis: The warning improves capital preservation or opportunity versus same-clock HOLD after actual delivery and conservative realistic execution constraints
lanes.baseline: HOLD, cash/no-action and cheapest delay-only or simple volatility risk-review control
lanes.falsifier: Missing real first delivery, no eligible fill or costs; intervention misses upside or has worse after-cost utility
lanes.decision_relevant_output: Paper-only risk-review utility with fully separated predictive accuracy, warnings delivered and executable fill assumption, else SCIENTIFIC_BLOCK
lanes.scientific_stop_condition: No real portfolio transactions, wallets, private holdings or automatic sell
lanes.reactivation_trigger: Authentic original delivery and policy-executable fill/fee/capacity and independent new events

lanes.name: Real original-owner engineering and S1 closure
lanes.hypothesis: A reproduced upstream fault can be fixed on the original branch and verified on main with actual natural consumer evidence
lanes.baseline: Current original PR/main SHA, existing CI and product/consumer status
lanes.falsifier: Tests fail or wrong owner/lease, no exact-head native CI, missing binding reviews, no actual merge or no producer acceptance
lanes.decision_relevant_output: Original-owner PR + exact HEAD CI + qualified merge/main blob + relevant production acknowledgment or specific gate/restart
lanes.scientific_stop_condition: Existing S1 only max3 original active PRs/tick, Monday 09:30-10:30 Copenhagen read-only; manual merge != S1
lanes.reactivation_trigger: New evidence-bearing original candidate PR passes binding source/security/reviews/CI and edit lease

lanes.name: Independent scientific and operational red team
lanes.hypothesis: Any materially positive claimed edge or release survives independent first-known, leakage, cohort and native receipt falsifiers
lanes.baseline: The cheapest null, always-HOLD or same-clock persistence and existing negative casebook
lanes.falsifier: Any future-source leakage, dependent event overcount, post-hoc winner, hypothetical fill or fake autonomous claim
lanes.decision_relevant_output: PASS_WITH_LIMITS, REJECT, SOURCE_REPAIR or SCIENTIFIC_BLOCK with reproducible counterexample and original-owner bind
lanes.scientific_stop_condition: Grok Bridge independent only when genuinely delivered; governed Sol MAX optional separate native one-shot approval, no invented agent
lanes.reactivation_trigger: Original new candidate source+test packet, real bridge report or sufficiently independent adversarial evaluator
